name: Lowe's Companies, Inc.
summary: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials,
style_reason: weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert
verdict: Einstufung: Standardwert (gemischt) – weder klarer Wachstums- noch klarer Value-Wert. Buffett-Score 40/100 (Eher nicht), Innovations-Score 16/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 208.87 USD (−10 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
